name: Japanese School Life
source:
You’re a foreign exchange student who is filled with anxiety and excitement as your dream of living in Japan is finally becoming a reality! Get ready to meet the diligent and good-natured girls that will be spending a majority of your time with you. It is going to be one crazy-fun year!

[From official website]
translation:
你是一名留学生，梦想着在日本生活，如今梦想终于成真，心中既期待又不安！准备好认识那些勤奋、善良，并将在大部分时间里与你相伴的女孩吧。这将是疯狂又欢乐的一年！

[来源：官方网站]
